P2_pairing_C_to_S.what_the_null_holds_fixed: the null re-pairs the SAME endpoint scores within the same protein, so protein level, compartment, burial and conservation are all held fixed and only the pairing varies
P2_pairing_C_to_S.conservatism: a protein with exactly two bonds has three possible matchings, one of them the true one, so the null contains the observed pairing with positive probability; this makes the test conservative rather than liberal

P2_proximity_control_post_hoc.declared_direction_before_computing: true-bond mean |difference| BELOW the separation-matched control mean |difference| (a negative difference)
P2_proximity_control_post_hoc.post_hoc: this control was added after P2 was computed, to address a confound P2's own permutation null does not remove. It is reported as post hoc, with its direction declared before it was computed.

diagnostic_all19_mean_gap.how_to_read_this: the same matched gap computed on the mean damage over all 19 substitutions instead of C->S alone. It is NOT a specificity test and no prediction was declared for it. At a bonded cysteine EVERY non-Cys substitution removes the bond, so a real bond-loss effect inflates this quantity too. A gap here of similar size to the C->S gap is therefore consistent BOTH with generic positional importance AND with uniform bond loss across substitutions, and cannot distinguish them. It is reported because it tells the reader how much of the C->S gap is specific to that substitution rather than present across the board.

legacy_verdicts.S5_control_compartment_placebo: NOT AVAILABLE - declared unavailable before running; too few cytosolic bonded cysteines exist to form an arm
